76190-a-confederate-surgeon-s-letters-to.creator: Unknown
76190-a-confederate-surgeon-s-letters-to.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. All the tents have been taken away from the men, and that, together with the change of climate from the coast of South Carolina to this place, has caused much sickness in our regiment. I will sleep in the medicine tent, a very comfortable place.

arxiv-1505-00048.title: PROPs for Linear Systems
arxiv-1505-00048.creator: Simon Wadsley, Nick Woods
arxiv-1505-00048.description: Abstract A PROP is a symmetric monoidal category whose objects are the nonnegative integers and whose tensor product on objects is addition. A morphism from m m to n n in a PROP can be visualized as a string diagram with m m input wires and n n output wires.

arxiv-2202-00610.title: First-order Temporal Logic on Finite Traces Journal: TOCL Volume: 0 0 0 0 0 DOI: 0000001.0000001 CCS: Theory of computation Modal and temporal logics CCS: Computing methodologies Temporal reasoning
arxiv-2202-00610.creator: Alessandro Artale, Andrea Mazzullo, Ana Ozaki
arxiv-2202-00610.description: Abstract . Formalisms based on temporal logics interpreted over finite strict linear orders, known in the literature as finite traces , have been used for temporal specification in automated planning, process modelling, (runtime) verification and synthesis of programs, as well as in knowledge representation and reasoning. In this paper, we focus on first-order temporal logic on finite traces .

arxiv-2211-06216.title: On the coadjoint Virasoro action
arxiv-2211-06216.creator: Anton Alekseev, Eckhard Meinrenken
arxiv-2211-06216.description: Abstract . The set of coadjoint orbits of the Virasoro algebra at level 1 is in bijection with the set of conjugacy classes in a certain open subset SL ~ ​ ( 2 , ℝ ) + \widetilde{\operatorname{SL}}(2,\mathbb{R})_{+} of the universal cover of SL ⁡ ( 2 , ℝ ) \operatorname{SL}(2,\mathbb{R}) .

arxiv-2303-07422.title: A variable star population in the open cluster NGC 6791 observed by the Kepler spacecraft
arxiv-2303-07422.creator: S. Sanjayan 1,2 , A.S. Baran 1,3,4 , P. Németh 1,5,6 , K. Kinemuchi 7,8 , J. Ostrowski 1 and S.K. Sahoo 1,2 1 ARDASTELLA Research Group, Institute of Physics, Pedagogical University of Cracow, ul. Podchora̧żych 2, 30-084 Kraków, Poland 2 Centrum Astronomiczne im. Mikołaja Kopernika, Polskiej Akademi
arxiv-2303-07422.description: Abstract We present the list of variable stars we found in the Kepler superstamp data covering approximately 9 arcminutes from the central region of NGC 6791. We classified the variable stars based on the variability type and we established their cluster membership based on the available Gaia Early Data Release 3 astrometry, by means of the Bayesian Gaussian mixture models.

arxiv-2405-10283.title: Power-law relaxation of a confined diffusing particle subject to resetting with memory
arxiv-2405-10283.creator: Satya N. Majumdar
arxiv-2405-10283.description: Abstract We study the relaxation of a Brownian particle with long range memory under confinement in one dimension. The particle diffuses in an arbitrary confining potential and resets at random times to previously visited positions, chosen with a probability proportional to the local time spent there by the particle since the initial time.

arxiv-2409-16797.title: Scalable Ensemble Diversification for OOD Generalization and Detection
arxiv-2409-16797.creator: Alexander Rubinstein, Luca Scimeca aaaaa, aaaaaaaa Damien Teney, Seong Joon Oh
arxiv-2409-16797.description: Abstract Training a diverse ensemble of models has several practical applications such as providing candidates for model selection with better out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, and enabling the detection of OOD samples via Bayesian principles. An existing approach to diverse ensemble training encourages the models to disagree on provided OOD samples.

arxiv-2502-05016.title: Impact of Model Mismatch on DOA Estimation with MUSIC: Near-Field and Far-Field
arxiv-2502-05016.creator: Don-Roberts Emenonye, Harpreet S. Dhillon, and R. Michael Buehrer
arxiv-2502-05016.description: Abstract There has been substantial work on developing variants of the multiple signal classification (MUSIC) algorithms that take advantage of the information present in the near-field propagation regime. However, it is not always easy to determine the correct propagation regime, which opens the possibility of incorrectly applying simpler algorithms (meant for far-field) in the near-field regime.

arxiv-2504-21856.title: Holography and Causality in the Karch-Randall Braneworld
arxiv-2504-21856.creator: Hao Geng, Lisa Randall
arxiv-2504-21856.description: Abstract It has been argued that the existence of a geodesic shortcut in the Karch-Randall (KR) braneworld rules out the possibility for a low-energy intermediate theory, even when gravity is turned off. We study this problem in an explicit example with two symmetrically placed KR branes.

arxiv-2505-08197.title: Visual Watermarking in the Era of Diffusion Models: Advances and Challenges
arxiv-2505-08197.creator: Junxian Duan, Jiyang Guan, Wenkui Yang, Ran He
arxiv-2505-08197.description: Abstract As generative artificial intelligence technologies like Stable Diffusion advance, visual content becomes more vulnerable to misuse, raising concerns about copyright infringement. Visual watermarks serve as effective protection mechanisms, asserting ownership and deterring unauthorized use. Traditional deepfake detection methods often rely on passive techniques that struggle with sophisticated manipulations.

arxiv-2505-12640.title: GDPRShield: AI-Powered GDPR Support for Software Developers in Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises Thanks: This work has been submitted to the EuroUSEC 2025 for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible.
arxiv-2505-12640.creator: Tharaka Wijesundara, Mathew Warren, Nalin Arachchilage
arxiv-2505-12640.description: Abstract With the rapid increase in privacy violations in modern software development, regulatory frameworks such as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) have been established to enforce strict data protection practices. However, insufficient privacy awareness among SME software developers contributes to the organization’s failure to comply with GDPR.

arxiv-2509-05756.title: Quantum Mpemba-like effect in Unruh thermalization
arxiv-2509-05756.creator: Zihao Wang, Wenjing Chen, Si-Wei Han, Xiaoshan Feng, Linmu Qiao, Zhichun Ouyang, and Jun Feng
arxiv-2509-05756.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zihao Wang, Wenjing Chen, Si-Wei Han, Xiaoshan Feng, Linmu Qiao, Zhichun Ouyang, and Jun Feng. We revisit the thermal nature of the Unruh effect within a quantum thermodynamic framework. For a Unruh-deWitt (UDW) detector in n n -dimensional Minkowski spacetime, we demonstrate that its irreversible thermalization to a Gibbs equilibrium state follows distinct trajectories on the Bloch sphere, which depend on the types of fields the detector interacts with, as well as the spacetime dimensionality.

arxiv-2602-12378.title: Investigating the Electronic and Magnetic Properties of Na x Fe 1/2 Mn 1/2 O 2 Cathode Materials with X-ray Compton Scattering
arxiv-2602-12378.creator: Veenavee Nipunika Kothalawala, Kosuke Suzuki, Johannes Nokelainen, Ilja Makkonen, Erica West, Lassi Roininen, Jere Leinonen, Pekka Tynjälä, Petteri Laine, Juho Välikangas, Ulla Lassi, Assa Aravindh Sasikala Devi, Matti Alatalo, Yuki Mizuno, Naruki Tsuji, Hikaru Usami, Yuju Nagasaki, Tsuyoshi Takami,
arxiv-2602-12378.description: Abstract We discuss electronic and magnetic properties of Na x Fe 1/2 Mn 1/2 O 2 , a promising Na-ion battery cathode material. Using x-ray Compton scattering, SQUID magnetometry, and density-functional-theory based modeling, we probe how electrons and spins evolve during sodiation.

pmc-11338330.title: Abstract 11: Multicomponent Cord Blood Bank Program, Beyond Transplantation
pmc-11338330.creator: Dinara Samarkanova, Nerea Castillo, Carmen Azqueta, Elena Valdivia, Lluis Martorell, Nuria Rubio, Elisenda Farssac, Jesus Fernandez-Sojo, Sergi Querol
pmc-11338330.description: IntroductionIn current public cord blood (CB) banking, many of the collected units are considered not suitable for hematopoietic stem cell transplant (HSCT) due to their low stem cell counts. New clinical applications are foreseen like specialized hemotherapy shown in the setting of wound healing (Samarkanova, 2020) or neonatal transfusion (Teofili, 2023).

pmc-11620152.title: Efficiency comparison of DNA extraction kits for analysing the cockle gut bacteriome
pmc-11620152.creator: Catarina F. Lourenço, Ana R. Almeida, Amadeu M.V.M. Soares, Catarina R. Marques
pmc-11620152.description: Cockles play a vital ecological role and provide valuable ecosystem services globally. However, the performance, production, and safe consumption of cockles are significantly influenced by their gut-associated bacteriome. Accurate understanding of gut-bacteriome interactions, and surveillance of pathogenic bacteria loads in cockles, rely on efficient DNA extraction methods that yield high-quality and representative bacterial DNA.

pmc-12477870.title: Natural killer cells in adoptive cell therapy: current landscape of genetic engineering strategies
pmc-12477870.creator: María Burón, Anne Etxebarria, Maite Álvarez, Irene Romayor, Cristina Eguizabal
pmc-12477870.description: Among adoptive cell-based immunotherapies, chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) therapy has shown promising results in cancer treatment. Treatment with CAR-T cells has produced remarkable clinical responses, especially in cases of relapsed and refractory leukemia and lymphoma. However, CAR-T cell therapy still presents several limitations, including some safety concerns related to neurotoxicity and aggressive inflammatory responses.

pmc-12478714.title: Estimation of Genetic Correlation Between Rheumatoid Arthritis and Multiple Sclerosis Using Summary Statistics from Genome-Wide Association Studies
pmc-12478714.creator: Ragıp Onur Öztornacı
pmc-12478714.description: Objective:Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have revolutionized our understanding of the genetic basis of diseases by examining millions of genetic variants across the genome. Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and multiple sclerosis (MS) are chronic autoimmune diseases characterized by immune system dysregulation and inflammation.

pmc-12546824.title: Plant-Based Diet Quality, Healthy Lifestyle, and Dementia Risk in Older Adults With Cardiometabolic Diseases
pmc-12546824.creator: Michelle M Dunk, Abigail Dove, Jiao Wang, Sakura Sakakibara, Adrián Carballo-Casla, Weili Xu
pmc-12546824.description: BackgroundCardiometabolic diseases (CMDs; heart disease, stroke, and type 2 diabetes) are associated with dementia risk, but whether a healthy plant-based diet and other lifestyle behaviors can mitigate this risk is unclear.ObjectivesThe purpose of this study was to investigate joint associations of CMDs, plant-based diet quality, and other lifestyle behaviors with dementia risk.

pmc-12697801.title: Operando X‐Ray Diffraction Study of MXene Electrode Structure in Supercapacitors with Alkali Metal Electrolytes
pmc-12697801.creator: Gui Li, Nicolas Boulanger, Bartosz Gurzęda, Susu Bi, Christoph Hennig, Alexandr V. Talyzin
pmc-12697801.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Ti‐MXene is a promising electrode material for supercapacitors. The layered structure of MXene expands due to swelling in electrolytes allowing the penetration of ions into the interlayers. A study of effects related to the match between the size of cations in hydrated or dehydrated state and the interlayer distance of MXene is performed here using operando X‐ray diffraction (XRD) in capillary‐size supercapacitors with alkali metal chloride electrolytes.

pmc-12820126.title: Motivational effectiveness of prosocial public health messaging to reduce respiratory infection risk: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12820126.creator: Aikaterini Grimani, Vivi Antonopoulou, Nicholas Meader, Chris Bonell, Susan Michie, Michael P. Kelly, Ivo Vlaev
pmc-12820126.description: BackgroundClear communication is essential for the effective uptake of public health interventions promoting protective behaviours for respiratory infection control. The emergence of novel infectious diseases, particularly the COVID-19 pandemic, has highlighted the need for rapid adaptation of established and new behavioural practices. However, there remains limited knowledge concerning effective strategies for disseminating risk-reduction information and predicting population responses.

pmc-13144508.title: Evaluating large language models for pharmacotherapy simulations: a mixed-methods study
pmc-13144508.creator: Ahmed N. Farrag, Amany El-Zeiny, Amani M. Ali
pmc-13144508.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Simulation-based learning is essential in clinical pharmacy education but requires substantial faculty resources that limit scalability. Large language models (LLMs) offer promise for generating scalable simulations, yet their pedagogical rigor and clinical reliability remain unclear. In a mixed-methods, counterbalanced evaluation study, PharmD students (n = 104) engaged with acute myeloid leukemia (AML) or chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) cases, conditions requiring complex longitudinal management yet sharing semantic similarity, generated by four LLMs using expert-guided meta-prompts.

pmc-13190721.title: Protective effects of colorless carotenoid precursors against UV-induced lipid oxidation in liposomes compared to lycopene
pmc-13190721.creator: Anna Heidrich, Volker Böhm
pmc-13190721.description: Consuming tomato-extracts can reduce the risk of developing chronic diseases. As lycopene supplementation alone had a weaker impact, the protective effect may be influenced by the colorless carotenoids phytoene and phytofluene. To obtain more insights into the effect of tomato-extracts, the three carotenoids were separately investigated.

pmc-13244822.title: Evaluating the reliability and educational quality of YouTube™ and TikTok™ videos on custom subperiosteal implants: a cross-sectional methodological analysis
pmc-13244822.creator: Göksel Tımarcıoğlu, Erdal Cem Kargu, Hülya Çerçi Akçay, Başak Tımarcıoğlu
pmc-13244822.description: BackgroundSocial media platforms such as YouTube™ and TikTok™ have become increasingly influential sources of oral health information. However, the reliability and educational value of videos on advanced surgical procedures, including custom subperiosteal implants, remain uncertain. This study aimed to evaluate and compare the quality, accuracy, and educational usefulness of YouTube™ and TikTok™ videos related to custom subperiosteal implant procedures.

pmc-13402282.title: Unraveling the Relationship Between Respiratory Metabolism and Post-priming Deterioration in Rice
pmc-13402282.creator: Jiayi Xu, Xiaowei Duan, Xing Chen, Lianlian Yan, Xiang Dan, Fangbo Cao, Jiana Chen, Huabin Zheng, Min Huang, Weiqin Wang
pmc-13402282.description: Seed priming has emerged as an effective and low-cost option to enhance rice seed vigor. However, the fast post-priming deterioration limits its adoption in rice production. The deterioration rate of primed rice seeds was varied across different priming methods, but whether this variation was associated with changes in seed respiratory metabolism remains unknown.

pmc-13450591.title: High-throughput microfluidics and machine learning-assisted screening of lipid nanoparticle formulations for siRNA delivery
pmc-13450591.creator: Mingzhi Yu, Luhan Wang, Dongsheng Liu, Jianqiang Guo, Jiahao Liu, Jiawei Zhou, Allen Mathew, Zhonglei He, Jing Wu, Nan Zhang

pmc-13562683.title: MRICombo: a deep-learning-based framework for universal volumetric segmentation grading-staging and malignancy detection across heterogeneous MRI
pmc-13562683.creator: Zhuoneng Zhang, Luyi Han, Dengqiang Jia, Yuanfeng Wei, Tianyu Zhang, Jiaju Huang, Da Huang, Yapeng Wang, Shandong Wu, Michiel Kallenberg, Ritse Mann, Chenggong Yan, Yue Sun, Tao Tan
pmc-13562683.description: Comprehensive magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) analysis in oncology involves multiple interrelated tasks including volumetric segmentation, grading, staging, and malignancy detection. However, most existing deep learning models are task-specific or sequence-specific, lacking the generalizability required for heterogeneous sequences. Here we present MRICombo, a unified multi-expert deep learning framework for universal anatomical delineation and tumor characterization across 9 heterogeneous imaging sequences.
